headlines.title_en: PBOC injects net 50 billion yuan into market via government bond trading in July
headlines.summary_en: The PBOC announced liquidity operations across various tools for July 2026. In central bank lending, the Standing Lending Facility (SLF) saw a net withdrawal of RMB 1 billion; the Medium-term Lending Facility (MLF) saw a net injection of RMB 100 billion, and the Pledged Supplementary Lending (PSL) saw a net withdrawal of RMB 116.1 billion. In open market operations, 7-day reverse repos saw a net injection of RMB 249.5 billion, outright treasury bond trading saw a net injection of RMB 50 billion, and central treasury cash management saw a net injection of RMB 30 billion.

headlines.title: 中国央行：8月5日将开展5000亿元买断式逆回购操作，期限为3个月
headlines.summary: 为保持银行体系流动性充裕，2026年8月5日，中国人民银行将以固定数量、利率招标、多重价位中标方式开展5000亿元买断式逆回购操作，期限为3个月（92天），到期日为2026年11月5日（遇节假日顺延）。

Among them, engineering contracting new contracts were RMB 650.648 billion, down 17.48%; green environmental protection was RMB 95.385 billion, down 11.17%; planning, design, and consulting was RMB 7.556 billion, down 24.93%; industrial manufacturing was RMB 17.61 billion, up 8.59%; real estate development was RMB 27.237 billion, down 25.95%; materials and logistics was RMB 68.267 billion, down 20.07%; industrial finance was RMB 3.589 billion, down 11.00%; emerging industries was RMB 7.867 billion, up 0.11%.

headlines.title: China’s debt ratio dips as households cut borrowing and firms slash investment: report
headlines.summary:
China’s debt-to-GDP ratio fell in the second quarter for the first time since 2022, even as the government kept borrowing while households and private companies pulled back under the weight of falling home prices, sluggish income growth and shrinking profit margins, according to a new report.

headlines.title_en: July property market defies off-season: Multiple cities see year-on-year sales growth, Shanghai luxury project sells out on opening day
headlines.summary_en: In July, affected by high temperatures combined with the traditional off-season, property transactions in key cities weakened month-on-month, but remained resilient overall compared to the same period last year, with many cities seeing year-on-year growth in new and second-hand home transactions. In particular, high-end improvement properties in Shanghai's core districts performed strongly, with luxury projects seeing same-day sellouts at launch.

headlines.title_en: Ministry of Finance plans to issue 2026 book-entry discount bonds (47th tranche) with tender face value of 20 billion yuan
headlines.summary_en: Jin10 Data, August 4 - The Ministry of Finance plans to issue the 2026 book-entry discount (47th issue) treasury bonds. This issue is a 28-day discount bond. The competitive bidding face value totals RMB 20 billion, with additional bidding allowed for Class A members. The issue price will be determined through competitive bidding and issued at a discount below face value. Interest accrues from August 6, 2026, with repayment at face value on September 3, 2026 (postponed if holidays fall on that date). Bidding time is from 10:35 to 11:35 AM on August 5, 2026.

headlines.summary: 7月28日，市场监管总局在北京召开深入贯彻落实公平竞争审查制度专项行动推进会，听取有关地方工作进展情况，总结阶段性工作成效，部署推动下一阶段重点工作任务。总局党组成员、副局长孟扬出席会议并讲话。 专项行动围绕加快构建全国统一大市场，坚持问题导向，聚焦基层开展公平竞争审查存在的问题，针对性部署15项具体任务，指导各地结合实际扎实推进，取得阶段性工作成效，为公平竞争审查落地见效提供了有力保障。

headlines.title_en: SAMR holds meeting to advance special action on implementing fair competition review system
headlines.summary_en: On July 28, the State Administration for Market Regulation held a work promotion meeting in Beijing to deeply implement the special action on fair competition review, hearing progress reports from relevant local authorities, summarizing phased achievements, and deploying key tasks for the next stage. Party Group Member and Deputy Director Meng Yang attended and spoke. The special action focuses on accelerating the construction of a unified national market, adheres to a problem-oriented approach, targets issues in grassroots fair competition review, and deploys 15 specific tasks to guide localities in solid implementation, achieving phased results and providing strong support for the effective implementation of fair competition review.

headlines.title_en: SAMR: To conduct key spot checks on regions with strong corporate complaints about improper market intervention pain points and prominent fair competition issues
headlines.summary_en: Jin10 Data, August 4 - On July 28, the State Administration for Market Regulation held a work promotion meeting in Beijing to deeply implement the special action on fair competition review, hearing progress reports from relevant local authorities, summarizing phased achievements, and deploying key tasks for the next stage. Party Group Member and Deputy Director Meng Yang attended and spoke. The meeting noted that the special action focuses on accelerating the construction of a unified national market, adheres to a problem-oriented approach, targets issues in grassroots fair competition review, and deploys 15 specific tasks to guide localities in solid implementation, achieving phased results and providing strong support for the effective implementation of fair competition review. The meeting emphasized continued efforts in strictly standardizing reviews, strengthening supervision and safeguards, enhancing review capabilities, and intensifying publicity and advocacy to further promote the in-depth implementation of the fair competition review system, ensuring that all reviews that should be conducted are conducted and all regulations are applied.

headlines.title: 工信部：对于L3级自动驾驶系统应具备驾驶人接管能力监测功能
headlines.summary: 《智能网联汽车 自动驾驶系统安全要求》强制性国家标准正式发布。拟于2027年7月1日起正式实施。其中提到，该标准立足我国产业发展与行业监管实际需求，兼顾技术可行性、产业适配性与落地实操性，构建了维度完整、要求清晰、适配国情的安全要求体系。规范人机交互与用户告知要求，防范误用滥用风险。标准要求自动驾驶系统的激活和退出过程应安全，并明确就绪、激活、退出等状态信息及信号的提示规范。对于L3级自动驾驶系统还应具备驾驶人接管能力监测功能。

headlines.title_en: MIIT: L3-level autonomous driving systems should include driver takeover capability monitoring functions
headlines.summary_en: The mandatory national standard "Intelligent Connected Vehicles - Safety Requirements for Automated Driving Systems" has been officially released, scheduled to take effect on July 1, 2027. It states that the standard is based on China's industrial development and industry regulatory needs, balancing technical feasibility, industrial adaptability, and practical operability, establishing a safety requirements system with complete dimensions, clear requirements, and suitability for national conditions. It standardizes human-machine interaction and user notification requirements to prevent misuse and abuse risks. The standard requires that the activation and exit processes of automated driving systems be safe, and clarifies prompt specifications for status information and signals such as ready, activated, and exited. For L3 automated driving systems, a driver takeover capability monitoring function is also required.

headlines.title: 路透：特朗普政府正起草针对中国数据中心设备的禁令
headlines.summary: 据路透消息，特朗普政府正在起草一项禁令，禁止美国进口中国生产的新款数据中心零部件。负责监管美国电信行业的联邦通信委员会正在着手制定相关措施，禁止进口新型中国光收发器，这种设备能让数据在数据中心内通过光缆以光速传输。官员们希望能在今年内公布这项措施，届时将正式生效。

headlines.title_en: Reuters: Trump administration drafting ban on Chinese data center equipment
headlines.summary_en: According to Reuters, the Trump administration is drafting a ban prohibiting U.S. imports of new data center components made in China. The Federal Communications Commission, which regulates the U.S. telecommunications industry, is working on measures to ban imports of new Chinese optical transceivers, devices that enable data to travel at light speed through fiber-optic cables within data centers. Officials hope to unveil the measure within this year, at which point it will take effect.

headlines.title: 南向资金今日净买入25.7亿元
headlines.summary: 南向资金今日净买入25.7亿元。港股通（沪）方面，阿里巴巴-W、华虹宏力分别获净买入11.36亿港元、3.38亿港元；美团-W净卖出额居首，金额为10.65亿港元；港股通（深）方面，中芯国际、华虹宏力分别获净买入13.04亿港元、8.45亿港元；美团-W净卖出额居首，金额为1.62亿港元。

headlines.title_en: Southbound capital net inflow reaches 2.57 billion yuan today
headlines.summary_en: Southbound capital saw a net purchase of RMB 2.57 billion today. On the Shanghai-Hong Kong Stock Connect, Alibaba-W and Hua Hong Semiconductor saw net purchases of HK$1.136 billion and HK$338 million respectively; Meituan-W ranked first in net selling at HK$1.065 billion. On the Shenzhen-Hong Kong Stock Connect, SMIC and Hua Hong Semiconductor saw net purchases of HK$1.304 billion and HK$845 million respectively; Meituan-W ranked first in net selling at HK$162 million.

headlines.summary: 工业和信息化部装备工业一司8月4日组织道路机动车辆检验检测机构开展座谈，分析当前产品安全和检验检测工作形势，部署规范道路机动车辆检验检测行业竞争秩序、提升检验检测工作质量相关工作。会议要求，道路机动车辆检验检测机构要深入贯彻落实党中央、国务院决策部署，坚决抵制非理性竞争，严把产品检测关。

headlines.title_en: MIIT: Strengthen identification and testing verification of risky 'aggressive' innovative designs for road motor vehicle products, and enhance safety assessment of combined driving assistance and autonomous driving functions
headlines.summary_en: On August 4, the Equipment Industry Division I of the Ministry of Industry and Information Technology organized a symposium with road motor vehicle inspection and testing institutions to analyze the current situation of product safety and inspection work, and to deploy efforts to regulate industry competition order and improve the quality of inspection work. The meeting required road motor vehicle inspection institutions to thoroughly implement the decisions and deployments of the Party Central Committee and the State Council, resolutely resist irrational competition, and strictly uphold product testing standards.

headlines.title: 大金重工：签署约10亿元散货船建造合同
headlines.summary: 大金重工(002487.SZ)公告称，公司下属子公司唐山大金海工海洋工程有限公司与挪威某船东签署2艘211,000DWT散货船建造合同，总金额折合人民币约10亿元，将于2029年分批交付。该合同属于日常经营性合同，无需董事会和股东会审议。合同的签订标志着公司船舶建造能力获国际头部船东认可，预计将对公司未来经营业绩产生积极影响。

headlines.title_en: Dajin Heavy Industry: Signs bulk carrier construction contract worth approximately RMB 1 billion
headlines.summary_en: Dajin Heavy Industry (002487.SZ) announced that its subsidiary Tangshan Dajin Hai Gong Marine Engineering Co., Ltd. signed contracts with a Norwegian shipowner to build 2 bulk carriers of 211,000 DWT each, with a total value equivalent to approximately RMB 1 billion, to be delivered in batches by 2029. The contracts are routine operational contracts and do not require board or shareholder approval. The signing marks international recognition of the company's shipbuilding capabilities by a top-tier shipowner and is expected to have a positive impact on future operating results.

headlines.title: 惠云钛业：拟以2000万元-3000万元回购公司股份
headlines.summary: 惠云钛业公告，拟以不低于人民币2000万元且不超过人民币3000万元回购公司股份，回购价格不超过人民币9.5元/股。回购股份将用于转换公司发行的可转换为股票的公司债券，若未能在回购完成后的36个月内用于上述用途，未使用部分将予以注销。

headlines.title_en: Huiyun Titanium: Plans to repurchase company shares for RMB 20 million-30 million
headlines.summary_en: Huiyun Titanium announced plans to repurchase its own shares for no less than RMB 20 million and no more than RMB 30 million, with a repurchase price not exceeding RMB 9.5 per share. The repurchased shares will be used to convert corporate bonds convertible into shares; if not used for that purpose within 36 months after the repurchase is completed, the unused portion will be cancelled.

headlines.title: 京东方：截至7月底累计斥资近5亿元回购A、B股股份
headlines.summary: 截至2026年7月31日，公司通过回购专用证券账户，以集中竞价方式实施回购公司股份，累计回购A股数量为85,892,600股，占公司A股的比例约为0.2363%，占公司总股本的比例约为0.2319%，本次回购最高成交价为5.94元/股，最低成交价为5.63元/股，支付总金额为499,924,820.18元（不含交易费用）。

headlines.title_en: BOE: As of end of July, spent nearly RMB 500 million cumulatively to repurchase A and B shares
headlines.summary_en: As of July 31, 2026, the company repurchased its shares through a dedicated securities account using centralized bidding, with a cumulative total of 85,892,600 A-shares repurchased, representing approximately 0.2363% of the company's A-shares and approximately 0.2319% of its total share capital. The highest transaction price in this repurchase was RMB 5.94 per share, the lowest was RMB 5.63 per share, and the total amount paid was RMB 499,924,820.18 (excluding transaction fees).
